_doc: T-3786: the 20th-22nd Prairie block walked in the published /walk/?year=1904 at 390x780 and 1280x800 (full detail, SwiftShader on the runner, so triangles and draw calls are the readings; frame times are not), by `node tools/front_yard_shots.mjs <site> /walk/ <out> --block 20th-22nd --viewport mobile|desktop --phase after|before [--layers front_yards,back_yards] --stands ...`. AFTER is the page as published with this change; BEFORE is the same page with the front_yards and back_yards layers taken out of the 1904 scene, so after minus before is what the block's yards cost where the visitor stands. Stands: the west side from 20th Street (2000 and 2010), 2130 from the street, 2010's and 2130's back yards 9 m out square to their kitchen doors, and the middle of Prairie at N -3478 (20th Street), -3598 (mid-block) and -3718 (22nd Street). Page errors: 0 at every reading.

desktop_1280x800.note: the BEFORE pass was not taken at desktop: a desktop stand streams for about a minute on the runner, and the layers' cost is the mobile column's, the same scene at the same stands

headless_whole_layer: tools/test_back_yards.mjs on the committed data/back_yards/1904.json: 72 surface meshes in 12 chunks, 6565 triangles, 6881 fixture boxes, 349 crop plants, 101 draws for the whole district
